FVTTCONDITIONS.Manager.Title: Custom Conditions
FVTTCONDITIONS.Manager.EscapeHint: Frozen: Break free rolls Strength (Athletics) against the effect's DC. Control one other creature to help the marked target; otherwise the target rolls. In combat, it must be the roller's turn. The GM confirms reach and determines falling creatures' landing positions.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Manager.OneHelper: Control at most one other creature to help break the ice.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Manager.Hint: Apply, edit, disable, and remove the custom conditions on selected Actors.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Manager.TargetHint: Target tokens first. If no targets are marked, controlled tokens are used.
FVTTCONDITIONS.Manager.Name: Name
